prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 14 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot. Use [Video 1] as the exact choreography, timing, camera movement, framing and editing source. [Image 1] is the lead dancer. [Image 1] is an appearance reference only, not a pose or a location. The ONLY change: the lead dancer is now the person in [Image 1].

LEAD ([Image 1])
The person from [Image 1] is the featured lead, with his or her own face, hair, body and clothes from the photo, in EVERY shot: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo). The same real person in every frame. Never drift back to the face of the lead dancer in the video. NO light blue cardigan, NO mint pleated skirt, NO grey tights, NO pink sneakers and NO copper-red hair unless [Image 1] shows them. The person replaces one dancer per shot and appears only once at a time:
- Shot 1 [0-6.75 s], wide crowd shot: the featured dancer near front center, the one in the light blue cardigan in the video.
- Shot 2 [6.75-14.2 s], hard cut, three-person passage: the front dancer at the apex of the triangle.

CREW
Keep the crew exactly as in the video: every other dancer stays the same adult in the same grey streetwear, with the same count, formation and spacing. Every crew dancer is an adult with an adult height and build. No other dancer takes the look of the person in [Image 1]; the lead's look is never copied.

REPLACEMENT
Fully replace the lead dancer: face, hair, body and clothing. Remove all ties, backpacks and straps. Keep each shot's exact cast count, formation and spacing; empty areas during whip pans stay empty. Transfer every dancer's footwork, jumps, crouches, turns, arm gestures and expressions exactly; the dance stays high-energy. Natural anatomy: one head on the dancer's shoulders, two arms, two hands, two legs each, no fused bodies. Hair and fabric follow the motion without flicker. No added props, bags, text or accessories.

LOOK
Full-colour footage, not black and white. Keep the source asphalt court with crisp white, blue and yellow painted lines, steep high overhead camera angle and original shot order, transitions and duration. Hard low golden-hour sunlight from the source direction with long, sharp shadows matching each new silhouette, cool teal-grey asphalt, warm skin, filmic contrast and fine grain. Match source focus and motion blur.

No children. No text, no logos, no watermark. No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.

- Shot 2 [10.8-15 s], hard cut, three-dancer passage: the front dancer at the apex of the triangle.

CREW
Every other dancer stays exactly as in the video: the same upright animals, the same look, the same count. No other dancer takes the look of the pet in [Image 1]; the lead's look is never copied.

REPLACEMENT

Transfer every dancer's footwork, jumps, crouches, turns, arm gestures and expressions exactly; the dance stays high-energy. Natural anatomy: one head, two front legs, two hind legs and one tail each, real round furry paws, no fingers, no human hands, no fused bodies. Fur follows the motion without flicker. No added props, bags, text or accessories.

LOOK
Full-colour footage, not black and white. Keep the source asphalt court with crisp white, blue and yellow painted lines, steep high overhead camera angle and original shot order, transitions and duration. Hard low golden-hour sunlight from the source direction with long, sharp shadows matching each new silhouette, cool teal-grey asphalt, filmic contrast and fine grain. Match source focus and motion blur.
